# TryIPTV

> TryIPTV is a prepaid IPTV subscription service offering live television and on-demand access through compatible devices and independent IPTV player apps.

Use the linked website pages for current facts. Pricing, trial terms, and refund conditions are governed by their respective pages. Device pages cover platform setup; player pages cover app configuration; guides explain concepts; help pages diagnose problems.

## Service

- [TryIPTV](https://www.tryiptv.com/): Service overview.
- [Pricing](https://www.tryiptv.com/pricing): Current prepaid plans, prices, and included connections.
- [Free trial](https://www.tryiptv.com/iptv-free-trial): Trial duration, access, and request process.
- [FAQ](https://www.tryiptv.com/faq): Common service and account questions.

## Setup

- [Setup overview](https://www.tryiptv.com/setup): General setup path from credentials to playback.
- [Device guides](https://www.tryiptv.com/devices): Choose instructions for a specific device or platform.
- [Android TV and Google TV](https://www.tryiptv.com/devices/android-tv-iptv): Platform-specific setup example.
- [Fire TV Stick](https://www.tryiptv.com/devices/firestick-iptv): Fire TV setup and installation steps.

## Player configuration

- [Player guides](https://www.tryiptv.com/players): Choose a third-party IPTV player guide.
- [TiviMate](https://www.tryiptv.com/players/tivimate): Configure TiviMate on compatible TV devices.
- [IPTV Smarters Pro](https://www.tryiptv.com/players/iptv-smarters): Configure IPTV Smarters and its login methods.

## IPTV concepts

- [Guides](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides): Browse educational explanations.
- [What is IPTV?](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides/what-is-iptv): Definition and basic viewing requirements.
- [What is M3U?](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides/what-is-m3u): Playlist format and stream entries.
- [What are Xtream Codes?](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides/what-are-xtream-codes): Server URL, username, and password login method.
- [M3U vs Xtream Codes](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides/m3u-vs-xtream-codes): Comparison and choice of connection method.
- [What is EPG?](https://www.tryiptv.com/guides/what-is-epg): Programme schedule data and its relationship to XMLTV.

## Troubleshooting

- [Help](https://www.tryiptv.com/help): Find the guide matching the failure symptom.
- [IPTV not working](https://www.tryiptv.com/help/iptv-not-working): Triage for a general failure.
- [Login not working](https://www.tryiptv.com/help/iptv-login-not-working): Diagnose rejected credentials or server access.
- [M3U not loading](https://www.tryiptv.com/help/m3u-not-loading): Diagnose playlist download or parsing failures.
- [EPG not working](https://www.tryiptv.com/help/epg-not-working): Diagnose missing or incorrect guide data.
- [IPTV buffering](https://www.tryiptv.com/help/iptv-buffering): Diagnose interrupted playback.

## Policies and contact

- [Refund policy](https://www.tryiptv.com/refund-policy): Current refund eligibility and request conditions.
- [Terms and conditions](https://www.tryiptv.com/terms-conditions): Subscription terms.
- [Contact](https://www.tryiptv.com/contact-us): Official support channels.
